scope: Native Anthropic chat and prompt caching adapter checkpoint; not full M4 acceptance
checks: Official IChatClient integration uses policy-owned HTTP with explicit endpoint and credential, no automatic retries and no SDK telemetry.
Final headers exclude ambient SDK custom headers and host metadata. A dedicated test run with synthetic environment credentials and headers passed all twenty adapter checks.
Chat supports streaming, function tools, structured schemas and declared adaptive reasoning. Stable system-prefix caching is explicitly declared and does not mutate caller history.
Input usage includes regular input, cache creation and cache reads; cached reads are also reported separately. Streaming usage is emitted once by the SDK.

Missing stop reasons, missing terminal stream records, invalid bodies, oversized responses, redirects and unsafe overrides fail with sanitized errors. Current policy is rechecked for retained clients.
Model discovery uses the native read-only URL, matching protocol version and configured authentication. Partial pagination fails visibly rather than presenting an incomplete model list.
packageAdvisories: No known vulnerabilities listed by NuGet for the restored dependency graph at this check
limitations: Native citation annotations are preserved but verified span-level citation integration is unfinished and is not advertised.
Native batch and OpenAI native adapter work remain open.
No live Anthropic qualification was performed. All new Anthropic tests use controlled local responses.
Remaining real-export, full operational deployment/restore, large-corpus and signed-release acceptance gates remain open.
